decisions.rationale: 2025 NOA $79,145 and pay stub (about $77,400 annualized, YTD consistent) support the stated $77,500.
Chequing balance $67,390 with steady history and no large deposits covers the $43,000 down payment and closing costs.
Summit Property Valuations (on panel), dated 2026-06-19, values at $445,000 against a $430,000 price with no conditions.
TDS about 48.3% (about 44.5% even if condo fees are half-counted) exceeds the 44% maximum, which is not marginal for a DTI-03 exception.
